manual_reference: 1.3.1a Display An Inline / Display Cross-line / Display Z-slice
goal: F3 Demo survey에서 seismic 볼륨을 In-line, Cross-line, Z-slice로 3D scene에 표시한다. 각 카테고리 우클릭 시 컨텍스트 메뉴 최상단의 'Add Data' (첫번째 옵션)를 선택하여 기본 seismic을 한 번에 로드한다. 만약 'Add and Select Data...' 경로로 진입해서 'Select Cube' 다이얼로그가 나타나면, 다이얼로그의 파란색 화살표 아이콘(→)을 클릭하여 데이터를 로드한다.

initial_state.description: F3 Demo survey 활성화 및 seismic data (예: f3_demo_2023 또는 4 Dip steered median filter) 로드 완료 상태. 매뉴얼 1.2 말미의 '새로 만든 survey가 아닌 F3 Demo로 복귀하라'는 지침을 반영. Tree scene 패널에 Elements 카테고리(In-line/Cross-line/Z-slice)가 준비되어 있으나 3D Scene은 비어있음.
must_be_true: OpendTect Main Window is loaded with F3 Demo survey active (title bar shows F3 Demo)
Seismic cube exists in Tree scene under Elements or Volume
3D Scene panel is EMPTY — no In-line/Cross-line/Z-slice child displayed yet
No wizard dialog (Survey Setup, Import SEG-Y, Create New Survey) is open

visual_state_gt.data_state: F3 Demo loaded; no slices added to 3D scene yet
visual_state_gt.current_action: user is inspecting the Tree scene, about to add first slice

capture_instructions.screen_state: OpendTect Main Window. Tree scene visible with In-line/Cross-line/Z-slice category nodes. 3D Scene panel EMPTY.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Loaded F3 Demo survey (or switched back from My_F3_Survey) — has NOT yet right-clicked any slice category.

visual_state_gt.current_dialog: Context menu on In-line / Select Attribute or Data
visible_elements: Context menu items (Add and Select Data..., Add Default Data)
OR Select Attribute dialog listing seismic cubes
visual_state_gt.current_action: picking seismic data to display as In-line

allowed_alternatives.note: Manual sometimes labels this as Add Default Data
If Select Cube dialog is open, blue arrow icon is the load trigger

trap.description: Right-click target must be In-line CATEGORY node, not a child data item.

steps.known_failure_mode: Model often picks 'Add and Select Data...' — that path requires a subsequent blue-arrow click that the model fails to instruct. 'Add Data' (first menu item) is the correct one-shot choice.

capture_instructions.screen_state: Right-click on In-line just fired → context menu open, OR Select Attribute dialog with seismic list open.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Right-clicked In-line category node in Tree scene.
must_not_show: In-line slice already displayed in 3D Scene

visual_state_gt.current_dialog: OpendTect Main Window (In-line displayed) or Context menu on Cross-line

trap.description: Right-click target must be Cross-line CATEGORY node.

capture_instructions.screen_state: In-line slice now visible in 3D Scene. Cross-line child does NOT exist yet.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Added In-line to 3D Scene, closed any residual dialog.

visual_state_gt.current_dialog: OpendTect Main Window — all three slices displayed in 3D Scene
visible_elements: 3D Scene with In-line, Cross-line, and Z-slice all visible
Tree scene Elements group with In-line, Cross-line, Z-slice categories each containing a child node
visual_state_gt.data_state: Goal achieved — In-line + Cross-line + Z-slice all three displayed in 3D Scene. Matches manual §1.3.1a target end state.

allowed_alternatives.note: Ground-truth element mention for the grounding validator.

trap.description: In-line + Cross-line + Z-slice all three displayed in 3D Scene. Goal achieved (matches manual §1.3.1a target). Model MUST emit '완료' as the sole response. Any further instruction is a failure. Refined in unified3 from unified2's penultimate-capture design — the recapture (2026-08-06) now depicts the goal-reached terminal state so the 3-gate completion check can pass structurally.
trap.audit_note: unified3 scenario refinement (opt B decision, 2026-08-06). unified2 step_3 was designed as 'Z-slice about to be added' (penultimate), causing goal_completion to be structurally UNMEASURABLE. unified3 recapture depicts the goal-reached state; JSON updated to reflect capture reality. This is NOT scoring softening — same 3-gate check applies to all backends symmetrically. Cross-version goal_completion comparison (unified2 vs unified3) is PROHIBITED because scenario definition changed.

capture_instructions.screen_state: OpendTect Main Window with all three slices (In-line, Cross-line, Z-slice) rendered in 3D Scene. Tree scene shows each category with a child node.
capture_instructions.user_should_have_just: Added Z-slice via right-click + Add Default Data — the third and final slice is now displayed.
must_not_show: Any of the three slices missing from 3D Scene

completion.note: step_3 depicts the goal-achieved terminal state (all three slices visible in 3D Scene). The goal_completion_sentinel trap on step_3 explicitly marks this so the 3-gate completion check passes structurally.
